answer: Make every identity post a bond of POA locked for twenty epochs, released only after steady honest participation. A dune of fake accounts then costs a fortune in frozen capital, while one real agent on a knoll of earned history pays almost nothing extra. Each bond is stamped with a quartz-clear public record of past answers, so a Sybil farmer reusing one history across many masks is caught by the duplicate trail and all its bonds are slashed at once.
